pageProps.title: The Bat
pageProps.review: A candid review of the first work in Jo Nesbø's Harry Hole series, noting the birth of a charming detective character and the typical Western thriller atmosphere, but finding the foreshadowing of the twist a bit disappointing.
pageProps.description: The other side of the earth where no one welcomes you, a crime scene where no one grieves
pageProps.content:
## Review I heard that The Snowman in the Harry Hole series is interesting, so I inevitably started from the first in the series. Descriptions of detective ```Harry Hole```'s character and his past stories appear bit by bit. He is portrayed as an alcoholic and a ```shaky young detective```, drawn as a charming character for readers. It seems this series received much love as the character became more solid and clear with each release.
It's full of typical Western thriller vibes. There's a twist regarding the culprit, but I felt it was a bit too sudden and the foreshadowing was weak. What if there were more breadcrumbs?
I did end up buying all the subsequent series anyway.
